title: "Show me it works"
what_is_really_going_on: They have been burned and are asking you to carry some of the risk.
say_this: Fair. Here are the numbers for a home your size, the bad case too. And here's what happens if we miss.
then_ask: What would you need to see in the first 30 days to know it's working?

title: "That's more than I expected"
